statement: Oracle Q1 FY2027 capital expenditure reached $28.5 billion with full-year FY2027 capex guidance unchanged at $90 billion to $95 billion, while free cash flow was negative $5.4 billion.
why: Capex held at guidance while cash flow turns negative shows the buildout is still being funded aggressively, which is what actually pays for GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Maintained capex guidance keeps accelerator and facility orders flowing even as free cash flow deteriorates.

evidence.excerpt: Capital expenditure hit $28.5 billion, up from $8.5 billion annually
capex guidance is unchanged at $90 billion to $95 billion

confidence.basis: Figures relayed within one fetched document; the capex and cash-flow quotes come from an outlet cited inside that document, not a separately fetched source.

dispersion: Free cash flow was negative $5.4 billion against negative $362 million in the prior-year quarter.
